decision: Intentional comparison-layout placement correction under dialect0.2.13 §19.5. Function addresses honor text_base0x400000 and stay disjoint from reserved device ranges; heap_base is the first4096-byte page after data. No transfer rule, published lift reference object, prior name, or old gate-pass claim changes.
